import ProductoCard from '@/features/product-management/ui/ProductoCard';
import ProductoForm from '@/features/product-management/ui/ProductoForm';
import Button from '@/shared/ui/Button';
import Card from '@/shared/ui/Card';
import EmptyState from '@/shared/ui/EmptyState';
import Header from '@/widgets/app-header/ui/Header';
import SectionEntrance from '@/shared/ui/SectionEntrance';
import SectionLottie from '@/shared/ui/SectionLottie';
import { useNegocio } from '@/features/business-management/model/NegocioContext';
import { useStockData } from '@/widgets/product-overview/model/useStockData';
import { money } from '@/shared/lib/format';
import { confirmar, showError } from '@/shared/lib/notify';
import {
  actualizarProducto,
  crearProducto,
  eliminarFotoProducto,
  eliminarProducto,
  subirFotoProducto,
} from '@/entities/product/api/productos';
import {
  categoriasDeInventario,
  categoriasExistentes,
} from '@/entities/product/model/categories';
import { claveCategoria } from '@/shared/lib/category';
import type { Producto, ProductoInput } from '@/shared/types';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Pressable, Share, ScrollView, Text, View } from 'react-native';

type FormState = { producto?: Producto } | null;

export default function InventarioScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { selected } = useNegocio();
  const { productos, loading, recargar } = useStockData(selected?.id);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<FormState>(null);
  const [guardando, setGuardando] = useState(false);
  const [categoriaActiva, setCategoriaActiva] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const categorias = useMemo(() => categoriasDeInventario(productos), [productos]);
  const categoriasSugeridas = useMemo(() => categoriasExistentes(productos), [productos]);
  const productosFiltrados = useMemo(
    () =>
      categoriaActiva
        ? productos.filter((producto) => claveCategoria(producto.categoria) === categoriaActiva)
        : productos,
    [categoriaActiva, productos],
  );
  const productosBajos = useMemo(
    () => productos.filter((producto) => producto.stock <= producto.stock_minimo),
    [productos]
  );

  const guardar = async (
    input: ProductoInput,
    foto?: { uri: string; base64: string }
  ) => {
    if (!selected) return;
    setGuardando(true);
    let fotoNueva: { path: string; url: string } | null = null;
    try {
      if (foto) {
        fotoNueva = await subirFotoProducto(selected.id, foto.base64);
      }
      const datos = { ...input, foto_path: fotoNueva?.path ?? input.foto_path };
      if (form?.producto) {
        await actualizarProducto(form.producto.id, datos);
      } else {
        await crearProducto(selected.id, datos);
      }

      const fotoAnterior = form?.producto?.foto_path;
      if (fotoAnterior && fotoAnterior !== datos.foto_path) {
        try {
          await eliminarFotoProducto(fotoAnterior);
        } catch (error) {
          showError(error, 'Producto guardado; no pudimos eliminar la foto anterior');
        }
      }

      setForm(null);
      await recargar();
    } catch (error) {
      if (fotoNueva) {
        try {
          await eliminarFotoProducto(fotoNueva.path);
        } catch (cleanupError) {
          showError(cleanupError, 'No pudimos limpiar la foto que no se guardó');
        }
      }
      showError(error, 'No pudimos guardar el producto');
    } finally {
      setGuardando(false);
    }
  };

  const borrar = (producto: Producto) =>
    confirmar(
      'Eliminar producto',
      `¿Quieres eliminar "${producto.nombre}"? Las ventas anteriores se conservarán.`,
      async () => {
        try {
          await eliminarProducto(producto.id);
          await recargar();
          if (producto.foto_path) {
            try {
              await eliminarFotoProducto(producto.foto_path);
            } catch (error) {
              showError(error, 'Producto eliminado; no pudimos borrar su foto');
            }
          }
        } catch (error) {
          showError(error, 'No pudimos eliminar el producto');
        }
      }
    );

  const compartirReposicion = async () => {
    if (!selected || productosBajos.length === 0) return;
    const lineas = productosBajos.map((producto) => {
      const faltan = Math.max(producto.stock_minimo - producto.stock, 1);
      return `• ${producto.nombre}: pedir ${faltan} (hay ${producto.stock})`;
    });
    try {
      await Share.share({
        title: `Reposición para ${selected.nombre}`,
        message: `Lista de reposición — ${selected.nombre}\n\n${lineas.join('\n')}`,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      showError(error, 'No pudimos compartir la lista de reposición');
    }
  };

  if (!selected) {
    return (
      <View className="flex-1 bg-[#f3f8f2]">
        <Header eyebrow="StockYa" title="Inventario" />
        <View className="p-4">
          <Card>
            <EmptyState
              title="Crea tu tienda primero"
              message="Agrega un negocio para empezar a cargar productos y controlar su stock."
              actionLabel="Crear negocio"
              icon="storefront-outline"
              onAction={() => router.push('/negocios')}
            />
          </Card>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View className="flex-1 bg-[#f3f8f2]">
      <Header
        eyebrow={selected.nombre}
        title="Inventario"
        rightAction={{
          label: 'Agregar',
          icon: 'add-circle-outline',
          onPress: () => setForm({}),
        }}
      />
      <ScrollView
        contentContainerClassName="gap-4 p-4 pb-10"
        keyboardShouldPersistTaps="always"
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      >
        <SectionLottie
          variant="store"
          title="Cada producto en su lugar"
          caption="Controla cantidades, precios y lo que necesitas reponer."
        />

        <Card delay={40} className="gap-3">
          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3">
            <View className="h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-[#ddf4e6]">
              <Ionicons name="cube" size={21} color="#16896a" />
            </View>
            <View className="flex-1">
              <Text className="text-sm font-extrabold text-[#243b38]">
                {productos.length} {productos.length === 1 ? 'producto' : 'productos'}
              </Text>
              <Text className="text-xs text-[#71817b]">en el inventario de {selected.nombre}</Text>
            </View>
            <View className="items-end">
              <Text className="text-lg font-black text-[#b84c37]">{productosBajos.length}</Text>
              <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-[#9a6b19]">por reponer</Text>
            </View>
          </View>
          {productosBajos.length > 0 ? (
            <Button
              title="Compartir lista de reposición"
              icon="logo-whatsapp"
              variant="outline"
              onPress={compartirReposicion}
            />
          ) : (
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#e2f5e9] px-3 py-2.5">
              <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={17} color="#1a9c70" />
              <Text className="flex-1 text-xs font-semibold text-[#137656]">
                Todo en orden: no hay productos bajo el mínimo.
              </Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </Card>

        {loading && productos.length === 0 ? (
          <Card delay={100} className="items-center gap-2 py-8">
            <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#71817b]">Cargando inventario...</Text>
          </Card>
        ) : productos.length === 0 ? (
          <Card>
            <EmptyState
              title="Tu inventario está vacío"
              message="Agrega productos con su precio, costo y stock mínimo para empezar."
              actionLabel="Agregar primer producto"
              icon="cube-outline"
              onAction={() => setForm({})}
            />
          </Card>
        ) : (
          <>
            <ScrollView
              horizontal
              showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
              contentContainerClassName="gap-2 px-1"
            >
              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityState={{ selected: categoriaActiva === null }}
                onPress={() => setCategoriaActiva(null)}
                className={`rounded-full border px-3.5 py-2 ${
                  categoriaActiva === null
                    ? 'border-[#16896a] bg-[#16896a]'
                    : 'border-[#e5e8df] bg-[#fffefa]'
                }`}
              >
                <Text
                  className={`text-xs font-bold ${
                    categoriaActiva === null ? 'text-white' : 'text-[#5d706c]'
                  }`}
                >
                  Todas · {productos.length}
                </Text>
              </Pressable>
              {categorias.map((categoria) => {
                const clave = claveCategoria(categoria);
                const activa = categoriaActiva === clave;
                const cantidad = productos.filter(
                  (producto) => claveCategoria(producto.categoria) === clave,
                ).length;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={clave}
                    accessibilityRole="button"
                    accessibilityState={{ selected: activa }}
                    onPress={() => setCategoriaActiva(clave)}
                    className={`rounded-full border px-3.5 py-2 ${
                      activa ? 'border-[#16896a] bg-[#16896a]' : 'border-[#e5e8df] bg-[#fffefa]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Text className={`text-xs font-bold ${activa ? 'text-white' : 'text-[#5d706c]'}`}>
                      {categoria} · {cantidad}
                    </Text>
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>

            <View className="flex-row items-end justify-between px-1">
              <View>
                <Text className="text-lg font-extrabold text-[#243b38]">Tus productos</Text>
                <Text className="text-xs text-[#71817b]">
                  {productosFiltrados.length} {productosFiltrados.length === 1 ? 'producto' : 'productos'} · toca para editar
                </Text>
              </View>
              <Text className="text-xs font-bold text-[#5d706c]">{money(
                productos.reduce((total, producto) => total + producto.stock * producto.costo, 0)
              )}</Text>
            </View>
            <View className="gap-2.5">
              {productosFiltrados.length === 0 ? (
                <Card>
                  <EmptyState
                    title="No hay productos en esta categoría"
                    message="Prueba con otra categoría o vuelve a mostrar todo el inventario."
                    actionLabel="Ver todas"
                    icon="albums-outline"
                    onAction={() => setCategoriaActiva(null)}
                  />
                </Card>
              ) : (
                productosFiltrados.map((producto, index) => (
                <SectionEntrance key={producto.id} delay={Math.min(index * 35, 280)}>
                  <ProductoCard
                    producto={producto}
                    onEdit={() => setForm({ producto })}
                    onDelete={() => borrar(producto)}
                  />
                </SectionEntrance>
                ))
              )}
            </View>
          </>
        )}
      </ScrollView>

      <ProductoForm
        key={form ? form.producto?.id ?? 'nuevo' : 'cerrado'}
        visible={form !== null}
        inicial={form?.producto}
        categorias={categoriasSugeridas}
        saving={guardando}
        onSubmit={guardar}
        onClose={() => setForm(null)}
      />
    </View>
  );
}

import AuthShell from '@/shared/ui/AuthShell';
import Button from '@/shared/ui/Button';
import Input from '@/shared/ui/Input';
import TextLink from '@/shared/ui/TextLink';
import { signInWithGoogle } from '@/features/auth/api/auth';
import { flags, GOOGLE_WELCOME_STORAGE_KEY } from '@/features/auth/model/flags';
import { aviso, showError } from '@/shared/lib/notify';
import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Pressable, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import Animated, {
  useAnimatedStyle,
  useSharedValue,
  withDelay,
  withSpring,
  withTiming,
} from 'react-native-reanimated';

function LoginEntrance({ delay, children }: { delay: number; children: ReactNode }) {
  const opacity = useSharedValue(1);
  const translateY = useSharedValue(10);

  useEffect(() => {
    opacity.set(withDelay(delay, withTiming(1, { duration: 280 })));
    translateY.set(withDelay(delay, withSpring(0, { damping: 17, stiffness: 180 })));
  }, [delay, opacity, translateY]);

  const animatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    opacity: opacity.get(),
    transform: [{ translateY: translateY.get() }],
  }));

  return <Animated.View style={[{ width: '100%' }, animatedStyle]}>{children}</Animated.View>;
}

export default function Login() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const googleScale = useSharedValue(1);

  const googleAnimatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    transform: [{ scale: googleScale.get() }],
  }));

  const iniciarSesion = async () => {
    if (!email.trim() || !password) return aviso('Escribe tu correo y tu contraseña.');
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      flags.welcomeShown = false;
      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: email.trim(), password });
      if (error) showError(error, 'No pudimos iniciar sesión');
    } catch (error) {
      showError(error, 'No pudimos iniciar sesión');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const conGoogle = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    let welcomeStored = false;
    try {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(GOOGLE_WELCOME_STORAGE_KEY, 'true');
      welcomeStored = true;
      flags.welcomeShown = false;
      const signedIn = await signInWithGoogle();
      if (!signedIn) {
        flags.welcomeShown = true;
        await AsyncStorage.removeItem(GOOGLE_WELCOME_STORAGE_KEY);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      flags.welcomeShown = true;
      if (welcomeStored) {
        try {
          await AsyncStorage.removeItem(GOOGLE_WELCOME_STORAGE_KEY);
        } catch (cleanupError) {
          showError(cleanupError, 'No pudimos limpiar el intento de inicio con Google');
        }
      }
      showError(error, 'No pudimos entrar con Google');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AuthShell
      title="Inicia sesión"
      subtitle="Continúa con la gestión diaria de tu negocio."
      showWelcomeAnimation
    >
      <View className="w-full gap-4">
        <LoginEntrance delay={80}>
          <Input
            label="Correo electrónico"
            icon="mail-outline"
            placeholder="tucorreo@ejemplo.com"
            keyboardType="email-address"
            value={email}
            onChangeText={setEmail}
          />
        </LoginEntrance>

        <LoginEntrance delay={150}>
          <View className="gap-1.5">
            <Input
              label="Contraseña"
              icon="lock-closed-outline"
              placeholder="Tu contraseña"
              secureTextEntry
              value={password}
              onChangeText={setPassword}
            />
            <TextLink
              label="¿Olvidaste tu contraseña?"
              onPress={() => router.push('/forgot-password')}
              className="items-end"
            />
          </View>
        </LoginEntrance>

        <LoginEntrance delay={220}>
          <Button
            title="Iniciar sesión"
            variant="dark"
            icon="log-in-outline"
            onPress={iniciarSesion}
            loading={loading}
          />
        </LoginEntrance>

        <LoginEntrance delay={300}>
          <View className="gap-3 rounded-[22px] border border-[#ecebe3] bg-[#f8f8f3] p-3.5">
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3">
              <View className="h-px flex-1 bg-[#e2ded4]" />
              <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[1.4px] text-[#879792]">
                O continúa con
              </Text>
              <View className="h-px flex-1 bg-[#e2ded4]" />
            </View>

            <Animated.View style={googleAnimatedStyle}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={conGoogle}
                onPressIn={() => {
                  if (!loading) googleScale.set(withSpring(0.975, { damping: 16, stiffness: 300 }));
                }}
                onPressOut={() => {
                  googleScale.set(withSpring(1, { damping: 14, stiffness: 260 }));
                }}
                disabled={loading}
                accessibilityRole="button"
                className="flex-row items-center justify-center gap-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-[#e5e8df] bg-white py-3.5"
              >
                <Ionicons name="logo-google" size={19} color="#ea4335" />
                <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-[#243b38]">Continuar con Google</Text>
              </Pressable>
            </Animated.View>
          </View>
        </LoginEntrance>

        <LoginEntrance delay={380}>
          <View className="items-center border-t border-[#eeeae0] pt-3">
            <TextLink
              prefix="¿Eres nuevo?"
              label="Crea tu cuenta gratis"
              onPress={() => router.push('/register')}
            />
          </View>
        </LoginEntrance>
      </View>
    </AuthShell>
  );
}

import AuthShell from '@/shared/ui/AuthShell';
import Button from '@/shared/ui/Button';
import Input from '@/shared/ui/Input';
import TextLink from '@/shared/ui/TextLink';
import { emailConfirmationRedirectTo } from '@/features/auth/api/auth';
import { flags } from '@/features/auth/model/flags';
import { aviso, showError } from '@/shared/lib/notify';
import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { useState } from 'react';

export default function Register() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [nombre, setNombre] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const registrar = async () => {
    if (!nombre.trim()) return aviso('Escribe tu nombre.');
    if (!email.trim()) return aviso('Escribe tu correo electrónico.');
    if (password.length < 6) return aviso('La contraseña debe tener al menos 6 caracteres.');
    if (password !== confirm) return aviso('Las dos contraseñas deben ser iguales.');

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      flags.justRegistered = true;
      flags.welcomeShown = false;
      const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
        email: email.trim(),
        password,
        options: {
          emailRedirectTo: emailConfirmationRedirectTo,
          data: { full_name: nombre.trim() },
        },
      });
      if (error) return showError(error, 'No pudimos crear tu cuenta');

      if (!data.session) {
        router.replace({ pathname: '/check-email', params: { email: email.trim() } });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof TypeError && /fetch/i.test(error.message)) {
        showError(
          new Error(
            'No pudimos conectar con Supabase. Verifica que la URL y la clave pública sean del mismo proyecto, que tengas internet y reinicia Expo después de cambiar .env.'
          ),
          'Error de conexión'
        );
        return;
      }
      showError(error, 'No pudimos crear tu cuenta');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AuthShell
      title="Crea tu cuenta"
      subtitle="Empieza a llevar las cuentas de tu negocio."
      showWelcomeAnimation
    >
      <Input
        label="Tu nombre"
        icon="person-outline"
        placeholder="Ej. María Pérez"
        autoCapitalize="words"
        value={nombre}
        onChangeText={setNombre}
      />
      <Input
        label="Correo electrónico"
        icon="mail-outline"
        placeholder="tucorreo@ejemplo.com"
        keyboardType="email-address"
        value={email}
        onChangeText={setEmail}
      />
      <Input
        label="Contraseña"
        icon="lock-closed-outline"
        placeholder="Mínimo 6 caracteres"
        secureTextEntry
        value={password}
        onChangeText={setPassword}
      />
      <Input
        label="Repite la contraseña"
        icon="shield-checkmark-outline"
        placeholder="Escríbela otra vez"
        secureTextEntry
        value={confirm}
        onChangeText={setConfirm}
      />
      <Button
        title="Crear mi cuenta"
        variant="dark"
        icon="sparkles-outline"
        onPress={registrar}
        loading={loading}
      />
      <TextLink prefix="¿Ya tienes cuenta?" label="Inicia sesión" onPress={() => router.replace('/login')} />
    </AuthShell>
  );
}

import AuthShell from '@/shared/ui/AuthShell';
import Button from '@/shared/ui/Button';
import Input from '@/shared/ui/Input';
import { aviso, showError } from '@/shared/lib/notify';
import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Text, View } from 'react-native';

export default function ResetPassword() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const guardar = async () => {
    if (password.length < 6) return aviso('La contraseña debe tener al menos 6 caracteres.');
    if (password !== confirm) return aviso('Las dos contraseñas deben ser iguales.');
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password });
      if (error) return showError(error, 'No pudimos cambiar tu contraseña');
      aviso('Ya puedes usar tu nueva contraseña.', 'Contraseña actualizada');
      router.replace('/');
    } catch (error) {
      showError(error, 'No pudimos cambiar tu contraseña');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AuthShell
      title="Nueva contraseña"
      subtitle="Elige una contraseña segura que puedas recordar."
      showWelcomeAnimation
    >
      <View className="gap-3">
        <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-[#dcecdf] bg-[#f1f8f1] p-3.5">
          <View className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#ddf4e6]">
            <Ionicons name="shield-checkmark-outline" size={20} color="#16896a" />
          </View>
          <View className="flex-1 gap-0.5">
            <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-[#243b38]">Protege tu cuenta</Text>
            <Text className="text-xs leading-4 text-[#71817b]">
              Usa al menos 6 caracteres. Toca el ojo para mostrar u ocultar cada campo.
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>
        <Input
          label="Nueva contraseña"
          icon="lock-closed-outline"
          placeholder="Mínimo 6 caracteres"
          secureTextEntry
          value={password}
          onChangeText={setPassword}
          returnKeyType="next"
        />
        <Input
          label="Repite la contraseña"
          icon="shield-checkmark-outline"
          placeholder="Escríbela otra vez"
          secureTextEntry
          value={confirm}
          onChangeText={setConfirm}
          returnKeyType="done"
        />
      </View>
      <Button
        title="Guardar contraseña"
        variant="dark"
        icon="checkmark-circle-outline"
        onPress={guardar}
        loading={loading}
      />
    </AuthShell>
  );
}

import VentaExitosaModal from '@/features/product-management/ui/VentaExitosaModal';
import { colorStock } from '@/features/product-management/ui/ProductoCard';
import Button from '@/shared/ui/Button';
import Card from '@/shared/ui/Card';
import EmptyState from '@/shared/ui/EmptyState';
import Header from '@/widgets/app-header/ui/Header';
import SectionEntrance from '@/shared/ui/SectionEntrance';
import SectionLottie from '@/shared/ui/SectionLottie';
import { useNegocio } from '@/features/business-management/model/NegocioContext';
import { useStockData } from '@/widgets/product-overview/model/useStockData';
import { hoy } from '@/shared/lib/date';
import { money } from '@/shared/lib/format';
import { showError } from '@/shared/lib/notify';
import { registrarVenta } from '@/entities/sale/api/ventas';
import { categoriasDeInventario } from '@/entities/product/model/categories';
import { claveCategoria, nombreCategoria } from '@/shared/lib/category';
import type { Producto, Venta } from '@/shared/types';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Modal, Pressable, ScrollView, Text, View } from 'react-native';

export default function VenderScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { selected } = useNegocio();
  const { productos, loading, recargar } = useStockData(selected?.id);
  const [productoActivo, setProductoActivo] = useState<Producto | null>(null);
  const [cantidad, setCantidad] = useState(1);
  const [guardando, setGuardando] = useState(false);
  const [ventaExitosa, setVentaExitosa] = useState<Venta | null>(null);
  const [categoriaActiva, setCategoriaActiva] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const disponibles = useMemo(
    () => productos.filter((producto) => producto.stock > 0),
    [productos],
  );
  const categorias = useMemo(() => categoriasDeInventario(disponibles), [disponibles]);
  const productosFiltrados = useMemo(
    () =>
      categoriaActiva
        ? disponibles.filter((producto) => claveCategoria(producto.categoria) === categoriaActiva)
        : disponibles,
    [categoriaActiva, disponibles],
  );

  const abrirVenta = (producto: Producto) => {
    setProductoActivo(producto);
    setCantidad(1);
  };

  const confirmarVenta = async () => {
    if (!productoActivo) return;
    setGuardando(true);
    try {
      const venta = await registrarVenta(productoActivo.id, cantidad, hoy());
      setProductoActivo(null);
      setVentaExitosa(venta);
      await recargar();
    } catch (error) {
      showError(error, 'No pudimos registrar la venta');
    } finally {
      setGuardando(false);
    }
  };

  if (!selected) {
    return (
      <View className="flex-1 bg-[#f3f8f2]">
        <Header eyebrow="StockYa" title="Vender rápido" />
        <View className="p-4">
          <Card>
            <EmptyState
              title="Crea tu tienda primero"
              message="Agrega un negocio y tus productos para empezar a vender."
              actionLabel="Crear negocio"
              icon="storefront-outline"
              onAction={() => router.push('/negocios')}
            />
          </Card>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View className="flex-1 bg-[#f3f8f2]">
      <Header
        eyebrow={selected.nombre}
        title="Vender rápido"
        rightAction={{
          label: 'Stock',
          icon: 'cube-outline',
          onPress: () => router.push('/inventario'),
        }}
      />
      <ScrollView
        contentContainerClassName="gap-4 p-4 pb-10"
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      >
        <SectionLottie
          variant="sales"
          title="Una venta, un toque"
          caption="Elige un producto y registra la venta al instante."
        />

        <SectionEntrance delay={40}>
        <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-[#bfe7d2] bg-[#e2f5e9] px-4 py-3">
          <View className="h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#16896a]">
            <Ionicons name="hand-left-outline" size={18} color="#ffffff" />
          </View>
          <View className="flex-1">
            <Text className="text-sm font-extrabold text-[#1f574f]">Toca un producto para vender</Text>
            <Text className="text-xs text-[#4e6b65]">Elige la cantidad y el stock se descuenta solo.</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
        </SectionEntrance>

        {disponibles.length > 0 ? (
          <ScrollView
            horizontal
            showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
            contentContainerClassName="gap-2"
          >
          <Pressable
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityState={{ selected: categoriaActiva === null }}
            onPress={() => setCategoriaActiva(null)}
            className={`rounded-full border px-3.5 py-2 ${
              categoriaActiva === null
                ? 'border-[#16896a] bg-[#16896a]'
                : 'border-[#e5e8df] bg-[#fffefa]'
            }`}
          >
            <Text className={`text-xs font-bold ${categoriaActiva === null ? 'text-white' : 'text-[#5d706c]'}`}>
              Todas · {disponibles.length}
            </Text>
          </Pressable>
          {categorias.map((categoria) => {
            const clave = claveCategoria(categoria);
            const activa = categoriaActiva === clave;
            const cantidadCategoria = disponibles.filter(
              (producto) => claveCategoria(producto.categoria) === clave,
            ).length;
            return (
              <Pressable
                key={clave}
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityState={{ selected: activa }}
                onPress={() => setCategoriaActiva(clave)}
                className={`rounded-full border px-3.5 py-2 ${
                  activa ? 'border-[#16896a] bg-[#16896a]' : 'border-[#e5e8df] bg-[#fffefa]'
                }`}
              >
                <Text className={`text-xs font-bold ${activa ? 'text-white' : 'text-[#5d706c]'}`}>
                  {categoria} · {cantidadCategoria}
                </Text>
              </Pressable>
            );
          })}
          </ScrollView>
        ) : null}

        {loading && productos.length === 0 ? (
          <Card delay={80} className="items-center py-8">
            <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#71817b]">Cargando productos...</Text>
          </Card>
        ) : productos.length === 0 ? (
          <Card>
            <EmptyState
              title="Agrega productos para vender"
              message="Crea tu inventario y los productos aparecerán aquí en una cuadrícula rápida."
              actionLabel="Ir al inventario"
              icon="cube-outline"
              onAction={() => router.push('/inventario')}
            />
          </Card>
        ) : disponibles.length === 0 ? (
          <Card>
            <EmptyState
              title="No hay productos disponibles"
              message="Repón el stock de tus productos para volver a vender."
              actionLabel="Revisar inventario"
              icon="alert-circle-outline"
              onAction={() => router.push('/inventario')}
            />
          </Card>
        ) : (
          productosFiltrados.length === 0 ? (
            <Card>
              <EmptyState
                title="No hay productos con stock en esta categoría"
                message="Elige otra categoría para seguir vendiendo."
                actionLabel="Ver todos los productos"
                icon="albums-outline"
                onAction={() => setCategoriaActiva(null)}
              />
            </Card>
          ) : (
          <View className="flex-row flex-wrap justify-between gap-y-3">
            {productosFiltrados.map((producto, index) => {
              const estado = colorStock(producto);
              return (
                <SectionEntrance
                  key={producto.id}
                  delay={Math.min(index * 35, 280)}
                  style={{ width: '48.5%' }}
                >
                <Pressable
                  accessibilityRole="button"
                  accessibilityLabel={`Vender ${producto.nombre}, quedan ${producto.stock}`}
                  onPress={() => abrirVenta(producto)}
                  className="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-[26px] border border-white bg-[#fffefa] active:opacity-80"
                  style={{
                    shadowColor: '#51745f',
                    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 6 },
                    shadowOpacity: 0.18,
                    shadowRadius: 12,
                    elevation: 4,
                  }}
                >
                  {producto.foto_url ? (
                    <Image
                      source={{ uri: producto.foto_url }}
                      contentFit="cover"
                      style={{ width: '100%', height: 120 }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <View className="h-[120px] items-center justify-center bg-[#ddf4e6]">
                      <Ionicons name="cube-outline" size={36} color="#16896a" />
                    </View>
                  )}
                  <View className="gap-1.5 p-3">
                    <Text className="text-sm font-extrabold text-[#243b38]" numberOfLines={1}>
                      {producto.nombre}
                    </Text>
                    <Text className="text-base font-black text-[#16896a]">
                      {money(producto.precio_venta)}
                    </Text>
                    <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
                      <Text className="text-[11px] text-[#71817b]" numberOfLines={1}>
                        {nombreCategoria(producto.categoria)}
                      </Text>
                      <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold" style={{ color: estado.text }}>
                        {producto.stock} un.
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                  </View>
                </Pressable>
                </SectionEntrance>
              );
            })}
          </View>
          )
        )}
      </ScrollView>

      <Modal
        visible={productoActivo !== null}
        transparent
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setProductoActivo(null)}
      >
        <View className="flex-1 justify-end bg-black/50">
          <View className="gap-4 rounded-t-[30px] border border-white bg-[#fffefa] p-5 pb-8">
            <View className="mx-auto h-1.5 w-12 rounded-full bg-[#ddd5c7]" />
            <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
              <View className="flex-1">
                <Text className="text-xl font-extrabold text-[#243b38]" numberOfLines={1}>
                  {productoActivo?.nombre}
                </Text>
                <Text className="text-sm text-[#71817b]">
                  {productoActivo ? money(productoActivo.precio_venta) : ''}
                  {' · '}Disponibles: {productoActivo?.stock ?? 0}
                </Text>
              </View>
              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel="Cerrar"
                onPress={() => setProductoActivo(null)}
                className="h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#f4efe4]"
              >
                <Ionicons name="close" size={18} color="#5d706c" />
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            <View className="flex-row items-center justify-center gap-8 py-2">
              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel="Restar una unidad"
                disabled={cantidad <= 1}
                onPress={() => setCantidad((actual) => Math.max(actual - 1, 1))}
                className={`h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-[#fffef8] bg-[#e7e4da] ${
                  cantidad <= 1 ? 'opacity-40' : ''
                }`}
              >
                <Ionicons name="remove" size={26} color="#246b61" />
              </Pressable>
              <View className="items-center">
                <Text className="text-4xl font-black text-[#243b38]">{cantidad}</Text>
                <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#71817b]">unidades</Text>
              </View>
              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel="Sumar una unidad"
                disabled={cantidad >= (productoActivo?.stock ?? 0)}
                onPress={() =>
                  setCantidad((actual) =>
                    Math.min(actual + 1, productoActivo?.stock ?? actual)
                  )
                }
                className={`h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-[#fffef8] bg-[#e7e4da] ${
                  cantidad >= (productoActivo?.stock ?? 0) ? 'opacity-40' : ''
                }`}
              >
                <Ionicons name="add" size={26} color="#246b61" />
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between rounded-2xl bg-[#f4efe4] px-4 py-3">
              <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#5d706c]">Total de la venta</Text>
              <Text className="text-xl font-black text-[#246b61]">
                {money((productoActivo?.precio_venta ?? 0) * cantidad)}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <Button
              title="Registrar venta"
              icon="checkmark-circle-outline"
              onPress={confirmarVenta}
              loading={guardando}
              disabled={!productoActivo || cantidad > (productoActivo?.stock ?? 0)}
            />
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>

      <VentaExitosaModal venta={ventaExitosa} onClose={() => setVentaExitosa(null)} />
    </View>
  );
}

import Button from '@/shared/ui/Button';
import Card from '@/shared/ui/Card';
import Header from '@/widgets/app-header/ui/Header';
import SectionLottie from '@/shared/ui/SectionLottie';
import Input from '@/shared/ui/Input';
import { useAuth } from '@/entities/session/model/AuthContext';
import { useNegocio } from '@/features/business-management/model/NegocioContext';
import { aviso, showError } from '@/shared/lib/notify';
import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { inicialesUsuario, nombreCompletoUsuario } from '@/entities/user/model/user';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import type { Session } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import { useRouter, type Href } from 'expo-router';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform, Pressable, ScrollView, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import Animated, {
  useAnimatedStyle,
  useSharedValue,
  withDelay,
  withSpring,
  withTiming,
} from 'react-native-reanimated';

const MESES = [
  'enero', 'febrero', 'marzo', 'abril', 'mayo', 'junio',
  'julio', 'agosto', 'septiembre', 'octubre', 'noviembre', 'diciembre',
];

const miembroDesde = (iso?: string) => {
  if (!iso) return null;
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
  return `${MESES[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getFullYear()}`;
};

function PulsingAvatar({ iniciales }: { iniciales: string }) {
  const pop = useSharedValue(0.6);

  useEffect(() => {
    pop.set(withSpring(1, { damping: 10, stiffness: 160 }));
  }, [pop]);
  const popStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({ transform: [{ scale: pop.get() }] }));

  return (
    <View style={{ width: 80, height: 80, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
      <Animated.View style={popStyle}>
        <View
          className="h-20 w-20 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-4 border-white/90 bg-[#f3cf83]"
          style={{
            shadowColor: '#000',
            shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 5 },
            shadowOpacity: 0.2,
            shadowRadius: 8,
            elevation: 5,
          }}
        >
          <Text className="text-2xl font-black text-[#173f39]">{iniciales}</Text>
        </View>
      </Animated.View>
    </View>
  );
}

function StatTile({
  icon,
  label,
  value,
  delay,
}: {
  icon: keyof typeof Ionicons.glyphMap;
  label: string;
  value: string;
  delay: number;
}) {
  const y = useSharedValue(14);
  const o = useSharedValue(1);
  useEffect(() => {
    y.set(withDelay(delay, withSpring(0, { damping: 15, stiffness: 170 })));
    o.set(withDelay(delay, withTiming(1, { duration: 300 })));
  }, [delay, o, y]);
  const style = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({ opacity: o.get(), transform: [{ translateY: y.get() }] }));

  return (
    <Animated.View style={[{ flex: 1 }, style]}>
      <View className="items-center gap-1 rounded-2xl border border-white/15 bg-white/10 px-2 py-3">
        <Ionicons name={icon} size={18} color="#f3cf83" />
        <Text className="text-sm font-extrabold text-white" numberOfLines={1}>
          {value}
        </Text>
        <Text className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#bfe3d5]">
          {label}
        </Text>
      </View>
    </Animated.View>
  );
}

function MenuRow({
  icon,
  color,
  title,
  subtitle,
  href,
  delay,
}: {
  icon: keyof typeof Ionicons.glyphMap;
  color: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  href: Href;
  delay: number;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const x = useSharedValue(-16);
  const o = useSharedValue(1);
  const scale = useSharedValue(1);
  const arrow = useSharedValue(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    x.set(withDelay(delay, withSpring(0, { damping: 16, stiffness: 170 })));
    o.set(withDelay(delay, withTiming(1, { duration: 300 })));
  }, [delay, o, x]);

  const style = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    opacity: o.get(),
    transform: [{ translateX: x.get() }, { scale: scale.get() }],
  }));
  const arrowStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({ transform: [{ translateX: arrow.get() }] }));

  return (
    <Animated.View style={style}>
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => router.push(href)}
        onPressIn={() => {
          scale.set(withSpring(0.97, { damping: 15, stiffness: 300 }));
          arrow.set(withSpring(5, { damping: 12, stiffness: 260 }));
        }}
        onPressOut={() => {
          scale.set(withSpring(1, { damping: 13, stiffness: 260 }));
          arrow.set(withSpring(0, { damping: 12, stiffness: 260 }));
        }}
        className="flex-row items-center gap-3 rounded-[22px] border border-white bg-[#fffefa] px-3.5 py-3"
        style={{
          shadowColor: '#243b38',
          shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 2 },
          shadowOpacity: 0.04,
          shadowRadius: 5,
          elevation: 1,
        }}
      >
        <View
          className="h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl"
          style={{ backgroundColor: color + '1f' }}
        >
          <Ionicons name={icon} size={21} color={color} />
        </View>
        <View className="flex-1">
          <Text className="text-[15px] font-bold text-[#243b38]">{title}</Text>
          <Text className="text-xs text-[#71817b]">{subtitle}</Text>
        </View>
        <Animated.View style={arrowStyle}>
          <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={18} color="#a3b0ab" />
        </Animated.View>
      </Pressable>
    </Animated.View>
  );
}

function ProfileDetails({ session }: { session: Session }) {
  const { negocios, selected } = useNegocio();
  const nombreActual = nombreCompletoUsuario(session);
  const iniciales = inicialesUsuario(session);
  const [nombre, setNombre] = useState(nombreActual);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const heroO = useSharedValue(1);
  const heroY = useSharedValue(-12);
  useEffect(() => {
    heroO.set(withTiming(1, { duration: 350 }));
    heroY.set(withSpring(0, { damping: 15, stiffness: 160 }));
  }, [heroO, heroY]);
  const heroStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    opacity: heroO.get(),
    transform: [{ translateY: heroY.get() }],
  }));

  const proveedor = session.user.app_metadata?.provider === 'google' ? 'Google' : 'Correo';
  const desde = miembroDesde(session.user.created_at);

  const guardarNombre = async () => {
    const nombreLimpio = nombre.trim();
    if (!nombreLimpio) return aviso('Escribe tu nombre.');
    if (nombreLimpio === nombreActual) return aviso('No hay cambios para guardar.');

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ data: { full_name: nombreLimpio } });
      if (error) return showError(error, 'No pudimos actualizar tu nombre');
      aviso('Tu nombre se actualizó correctamente.', 'Perfil actualizado');
    } catch (error) {
      showError(error, 'No pudimos actualizar tu nombre');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Animated.View style={heroStyle}>
        <LinearGradient
          colors={['#125b49', '#16896a', '#36aa77']}
          start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
          end={{ x: 1, y: 1 }}
          style={{
            borderRadius: 28,
            padding: 20,
            overflow: 'hidden',
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderColor: '#76c895',
            shadowColor: '#16453e',
            shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 8 },
            shadowOpacity: 0.22,
            shadowRadius: 16,
            elevation: 5,
          }}
        >
          <View
            pointerEvents="none"
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              right: -30,
              top: -40,
              width: 160,
              height: 160,
              borderRadius: 80,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)',
            }}
          />

          <View className="items-center gap-2">
            <PulsingAvatar iniciales={iniciales} />
            <Text className="mt-1 text-center text-xl font-extrabold text-white" numberOfLines={1}>
              {nombreActual || 'Mi perfil'}
            </Text>
            <Text className="text-center text-sm text-[#d7ede4]" numberOfLines={1}>
              {session.user.email}
            </Text>
            {desde ? (
              <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-[#f3cf83]/35 bg-black/15 px-3 py-1">
                <Ionicons name="ribbon-outline" size={12} color="#f3cf83" />
                <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#f3cf83]">Emprendedor desde {desde}</Text>
              </View>
            ) : null}
          </View>

          <View className="mt-4 flex-row gap-2.5">
            <StatTile icon="storefront" label="Negocios" value={String(negocios.length)} delay={150} />
            <StatTile icon="star" label="Activo" value={selected?.nombre ?? '—'} delay={230} />
            <StatTile
              icon={proveedor === 'Google' ? 'logo-google' : 'mail'}
              label="Acceso"
              value={proveedor}
              delay={310}
            />
          </View>
        </LinearGradient>
      </Animated.View>

      <Card delay={120} className="gap-3.5">
        <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2.5">
          <View className="h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#e6f0e9]">
            <Ionicons name="person" size={17} color="#246b61" />
          </View>
          <View className="flex-1">
            <Text className="text-base font-extrabold text-[#243b38]">Datos personales</Text>
            <Text className="text-xs text-[#71817b]">Tu nombre aparece en el saludo de bienvenida.</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
        <Input
          label="Tu nombre"
          icon="person-outline"
          placeholder="Escribe tu nombre"
          autoCapitalize="words"
          value={nombre}
          onChangeText={setNombre}
          returnKeyType="done"
        />
        <Input
          label="Correo electrónico"
          icon="mail-outline"
          value={session.user.email ?? ''}
          editable={false}
          style={{ color: '#879792' }}
        />
        <Button
          title="Guardar cambios"
          icon="checkmark-circle-outline"
          onPress={guardarNombre}
          loading={loading}
        />
      </Card>

      <View className="gap-2.5">
        <Text className="px-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5d706c]">
          Accesos rápidos
        </Text>
        <MenuRow
          icon="storefront"
          color="#246b61"
          title="Mis negocios"
          subtitle="Crea, edita o cambia de negocio"
          href="/negocios"
          delay={200}
        />
        <MenuRow
          icon="wallet"
          color="#d99a36"
          title="Vender rápido"
          subtitle="Registra ventas y descuenta el stock al instante"
          href="/vender"
          delay={270}
        />
        <MenuRow
          icon="cube"
          color="#4c8ca0"
          title="Inventario"
          subtitle="Edita productos y comparte lo que debes reponer"
          href="/inventario"
          delay={340}
        />
      </View>

      <View className="mt-1 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2">
        <Ionicons name="shield-checkmark" size={14} color="#879792" />
        <Text className="text-xs text-[#879792]">StockYa · Tus datos están protegidos en la nube</Text>
      </View>
    </>
  );
}

export default function AjustesScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { session } = useAuth();

  return (
    <View className="flex-1 bg-[#f3f8f2]">
      <Header eyebrow="Tu cuenta" title="Mi perfil" showLogout />

      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={{ flex: 1 }}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
      >
        <ScrollView
          contentContainerClassName="gap-4 p-4 pb-10"
          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="always"
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        >
          {session ? (
            <>
              <SectionLottie
                variant="profile"
                title="Tu centro de control"
                caption="Administra tu cuenta y mantén tu tienda a tu manera."
              />
              <ProfileDetails key={session.user.id} session={session} />
            </>
          ) : (
            <Card className="gap-3">
              <Text className="text-base font-bold text-[#243b38]">Sesión no disponible</Text>
              <Button
                title="Ir a iniciar sesión"
                icon="log-in-outline"
                onPress={() => router.replace('/login')}
              />
            </Card>
          )}
        </ScrollView>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </View>
  );
}

import Button from '@/shared/ui/Button';
import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import LottieView from 'lottie-react-native';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, Pressable, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import Animated, { useAnimatedStyle, useSharedValue, withSpring } from 'react-native-reanimated';

type Estado = 'listo' | 'verificando' | 'exito' | 'error';

const primerValor = (value?: string | string[]) =>
  Array.isArray(value) ? value[0] : value;

export default function VerificarCorreoScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useLocalSearchParams<{ token_hash?: string | string[]; type?: string | string[] }>();
  const tokenHash = primerValor(params.token_hash);
  const tipo = primerValor(params.type);
  const [estado, setEstado] = useState<Estado>('listo');
  const [mensajeError, setMensajeError] = useState('');
  const [tieneSesion, setTieneSesion] = useState(false);
  const scale = useSharedValue(0.94);

  useEffect(() => {
    scale.set(withSpring(1, { damping: 16, stiffness: 160 }));
  }, [scale]);

  const cardStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    transform: [{ scale: scale.get() }],
  }));

  const confirmarCorreo = async () => {
    if (!tokenHash || tipo !== 'signup') {
      setMensajeError('El enlace no es válido. Solicita un nuevo correo de confirmación desde StockYa.');
      setEstado('error');
      return;
    }

    setEstado('verificando');
    setMensajeError('');
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({
        token_hash: tokenHash,
        type: 'signup',
      });
      if (error) throw error;
      setTieneSesion(Boolean(data.session));
      setEstado('exito');
    } catch (error) {
      setMensajeError(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : 'El enlace expiró o ya fue utilizado. Solicita uno nuevo desde StockYa.'
      );
      setEstado('error');
    }
  };

  const continuar = () => router.replace(tieneSesion ? '/' : '/login');
  const errorDeEnlace = !tokenHash || tipo !== 'signup';

  return (
    <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center bg-[#f5f4ed] px-5 py-10">
      <View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          right: -52,
          top: 60,
          width: 180,
          height: 180,
          borderRadius: 90,
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(52,138,118,0.08)',
        }}
      />
      <Animated.View style={[{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 440 }, cardStyle]}>
        <View
          className="items-center gap-4 rounded-[32px] border border-[#fffef8] bg-[#f3f0e7] px-6 py-8"
          style={{
            shadowColor: '#aaa596',
            shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 10 },
            shadowOpacity: 0.26,
            shadowRadius: 20,
            elevation: 6,
          }}
        >
          <View className="h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-[22px] border border-[#fffef8] bg-[#e7e4da]">
            <Ionicons
              name={estado === 'exito' ? 'checkmark-circle' : estado === 'error' ? 'mail-unread-outline' : 'mail-open-outline'}
              size={32}
              color={estado === 'exito' ? '#348a76' : estado === 'error' ? '#d66a54' : '#246b61'}
            />
          </View>

          <View className="items-center gap-1">
            <Text className="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-[2px] text-[#348a76]">
              StockYa
            </Text>
            <Text className="text-center text-2xl font-black text-[#243b38]">
              {estado === 'exito'
                ? '¡Correo confirmado!'
                : estado === 'error'
                  ? 'No pudimos confirmar'
                  : 'Confirma tu correo'}
            </Text>
            <Text className="mt-1 text-center text-sm leading-5 text-[#71817b]">
              {estado === 'exito'
                ? 'Tu cuenta ya está lista. Vuelve a tu tienda y comienza a vender.'
                : estado === 'error'
                  ? mensajeError || 'El enlace venció o ya fue utilizado. Solicita uno nuevo.'
                  : 'Presiona el botón para verificar tu dirección de correo y activar tu cuenta.'}
            </Text>
          </View>

          {estado === 'verificando' ? (
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-[#e7e4da] px-4 py-3">
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#246b61" />
              <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-[#246b61]">Verificando enlace...</Text>
            </View>
          ) : estado === 'exito' ? (
            <>
              <View className="h-28 w-28 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#e7e4da]">
                <LottieView
                  source={require('../../../../assets/lottie/success.json')}
                  autoPlay
                  loop={false}
                  style={{ width: 112, height: 112 }}
                  webStyle={{ width: 112, height: 112 }}
                />
              </View>
              <Button
                title={tieneSesion ? 'Entrar a mi tienda' : 'Iniciar sesión'}
                icon="arrow-forward"
                onPress={continuar}
              />
            </>
          ) : estado === 'error' ? (
            <>
              <Button
                title="Ir a StockYa"
                icon="arrow-forward"
                onPress={() => router.replace('/login')}
              />
              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                onPress={() => router.replace('/register')}
                className="py-2"
              >
                <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-[#246b61]">Crear una cuenta nueva</Text>
              </Pressable>
            </>
          ) : (
            <Button
              title={errorDeEnlace ? 'Ir a StockYa' : 'Confirmar mi correo'}
              icon={errorDeEnlace ? 'arrow-forward' : 'shield-checkmark-outline'}
              onPress={errorDeEnlace ? () => router.replace('/login') : confirmarCorreo}
            />
          )}

          <Text className="text-center text-xs text-[#879792]">
            Si confirmas desde el teléfono, vuelve a la app StockYa para iniciar sesión.
          </Text>
        </View>
      </Animated.View>
    </View>
  );
}

import type { Tipo } from '@/shared/types';
import { colors } from './theme';

export const TIPOS: Record<
  Tipo,
  { label: string; boton: string; color: string; icon: 'cart' | 'flash' | 'basket'; placeholder: string; signo: '+' | '-' }
> = {
  venta: {
    label: 'Venta',
    boton: 'Venta',
    color: colors.brand,
    icon: 'cart',
    placeholder: '¿Qué pidió el cliente? (ej. 2 almuerzos)',
    signo: '+',
  },
  gasto: {
    label: 'Gasto extra',
    boton: 'Gasto',
    color: colors.danger,
    icon: 'flash',
    placeholder: '¿En qué gastaste? (ej. luz, transporte)',
    signo: '-',
  },
  compra: {
    label: 'Compra de insumos',
    boton: 'Compra',
    color: colors.warn,
    icon: 'basket',
    placeholder: '¿Qué compraste? (ej. aceite, harina)',
    signo: '-',
  },
};

export const EMOJIS_NEGOCIO = ['🏪', '🍔', '☕', '💈', '👗', '🛠️', '🥖', '💊', '🍕', '📦'];

export const ICONOS_NEGOCIO = [
  'storefront-outline',
  'restaurant-outline',
  'bag-handle-outline',
  'briefcase-outline',
  'flask-outline',
  'laptop-outline',
  'fast-food-outline',
  'construct-outline',
  'cart-outline',
  'car-outline',
  'shirt-outline',
  'color-palette-outline',
] as const;

export type IconoNegocio = (typeof ICONOS_NEGOCIO)[number];

const ICONOS_POR_EMOJI: Record<string, IconoNegocio> = {
  '🏪': 'storefront-outline',
  '🍔': 'fast-food-outline',
  '☕': 'restaurant-outline',
  '💈': 'briefcase-outline',
  '👗': 'shirt-outline',
  '🛠️': 'construct-outline',
  '🥖': 'restaurant-outline',
  '💊': 'flask-outline',
  '🍕': 'fast-food-outline',
  '📦': 'bag-handle-outline',
  '🍽️': 'restaurant-outline',
  '🛍️': 'bag-handle-outline',
  '💼': 'briefcase-outline',
  '🧴': 'flask-outline',
  '💻': 'laptop-outline',
  '🧑‍🍳': 'fast-food-outline',
  '🧱': 'construct-outline',
  '🛒': 'cart-outline',
  '🚚': 'car-outline',
  '👕': 'shirt-outline',
  '🎨': 'color-palette-outline',
};

export function iconoNegocio(value: string | null): IconoNegocio {
  if (value && (ICONOS_NEGOCIO as readonly string[]).includes(value)) {
    return value as IconoNegocio;
  }
  return value ? ICONOS_POR_EMOJI[value] ?? 'storefront-outline' : 'storefront-outline';
}

export const SIN_CATEGORIA = 'Sin categoría';

export function normalizarCategoria(categoria: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  const normalizada = categoria?.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
  return normalizada || null;
}

export function nombreCategoria(categoria: string | null | undefined): string {
  return normalizarCategoria(categoria) ?? SIN_CATEGORIA;
}

export function claveCategoria(categoria: string | null | undefined): string {
  return nombreCategoria(categoria).toLocaleLowerCase('es');
}

const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');

export const fmtDate = (d: Date) =>
  `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`;

export const hoy = () => fmtDate(new Date());

export const diasAtras = (n: number) => {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - n);
  return fmtDate(d);
};

export const inicialDia = (fecha: string) =>
  ['D', 'L', 'M', 'M', 'J', 'V', 'S'][new Date(`${fecha}T00:00:00`).getDay()];

export const saludoDelDia = () => {
  const hora = new Date().getHours();
  if (hora < 12) return '¡Buenos días!';
  if (hora < 19) return '¡Buenas tardes!';
  return '¡Buenas noches!';
};

export const fechaLarga = (d = new Date()) => {
  const dias = ['domingo', 'lunes', 'martes', 'miércoles', 'jueves', 'viernes', 'sábado'];
  const meses = [
    'enero',
    'febrero',
    'marzo',
    'abril',
    'mayo',
    'junio',
    'julio',
    'agosto',
    'septiembre',
    'octubre',
    'noviembre',
    'diciembre',
  ];
  return `${dias[d.getDay()]} ${d.getDate()} de ${meses[d.getMonth()]}`;
};

export const money = (n: number) => {
  const [entero, decimal] = Math.abs(n).toFixed(2).split('.');
  return `${n < 0 ? '-' : ''}$${entero.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',')}.${decimal}`;
};

export const parseMonto = (texto: string) => Number(texto.replace(',', '.'));

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * Anima un número desde su valor anterior (o 0 al montar) hasta `value`
 * con una curva ease-out. Ideal para montos y contadores.
 */
export function useCountUp(value: number, duration = 750) {
  const [display, setDisplay] = useState(0);
  const fromRef = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const from = fromRef.current;
    const start = Date.now();
    let frame = 0;

    const tick = () => {
      const progress = Math.min(1, (Date.now() - start) / duration);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
      const current = from + (value - from) * eased;
      fromRef.current = current;
      setDisplay(current);
      if (progress < 1) frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };

    frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  }, [value, duration]);

  return display;
}

import { Alert, Platform } from 'react-native';

export const aviso = (mensaje: string, titulo = 'Revisa este dato') => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.alert(`${titulo}\n\n${mensaje}`);
    return;
  }
  Alert.alert(titulo, mensaje);
};

export const showError = (e: unknown, titulo = 'Algo salió mal') => {
  const mensaje = (e as { message?: string })?.message ?? 'Inténtalo de nuevo en unos segundos.';
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.alert(`${titulo}\n\n${mensaje}`);
    return;
  }
  Alert.alert(titulo, mensaje);
};

export const confirmar = (
  titulo: string,
  mensaje: string,
  onConfirm: () => void,
  textoBoton = 'Eliminar',
) => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    if (window.confirm(`${titulo}\n\n${mensaje}`)) {
      onConfirm();
    }
    return;
  }
  Alert.alert(titulo, mensaje, [
    { text: 'Cancelar', style: 'cancel' },
    { text: textoBoton, style: 'destructive', onPress: onConfirm },
  ]);
};

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import 'react-native-url-polyfill/auto';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

const supabaseUrl = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const supabaseAnonKey =
  process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY ??
  process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY ??
  process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_KEY;

if (!supabaseUrl || !supabaseAnonKey) {
  throw new Error(
    'Configura EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL y una clave EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY o EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_KEY en .env'
  );
}

export const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseAnonKey, {
  auth: {
    storage: Platform.OS === 'web' ? undefined : AsyncStorage,
    persistSession: true,
    autoRefreshToken: true,
    detectSessionInUrl: false,
  },
});

import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import LottieView from 'lottie-react-native';
import { ReactNode, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  ScrollView,
  Text,
  useWindowDimensions,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import Animated, {
  useAnimatedStyle,
  useSharedValue,
  withDelay,
  withSpring,
  withTiming,
} from 'react-native-reanimated';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

type Props = {
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  showWelcomeAnimation?: boolean;
};

export default function AuthShell({
  title,
  subtitle,
  children,
  showWelcomeAnimation = true,
}: Props) {
  const { height, width } = useWindowDimensions();
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const wide = Platform.OS === 'web' && width >= 900;
  const compact = height < 760 && !wide;

  const heroOpacity = useSharedValue(1);
  const heroTranslateY = useSharedValue(-10);
  const cardOpacity = useSharedValue(1);
  const cardTranslateY = useSharedValue(12);

  useEffect(() => {
    heroOpacity.set(withTiming(1, { duration: 300 }));
    heroTranslateY.set(withSpring(0, { damping: 16, stiffness: 180 }));

    cardOpacity.set(withDelay(80, withTiming(1, { duration: 320 })));
    cardTranslateY.set(withDelay(80, withSpring(0, { damping: 17, stiffness: 170 })));
  }, [cardOpacity, cardTranslateY, heroOpacity, heroTranslateY]);

  const heroStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    opacity: heroOpacity.get(),
    transform: [{ translateY: heroTranslateY.get() }],
  }));

  const cardStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    opacity: cardOpacity.get(),
    transform: [{ translateY: cardTranslateY.get() }],
  }));
  return (
    <View className="flex-1 overflow-hidden bg-[#f3f8f2]">
      <Animated.View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          right: -54,
          top: 100,
          width: 170,
          height: 170,
          borderRadius: 85,
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(22,137,106,0.08)',
        }}
      />
      <View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          left: -42,
          bottom: 80,
          width: 128,
          height: 128,
          borderRadius: 64,
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(241,124,91,0.08)',
        }}
      />
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={{ flex: 1 }}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
        keyboardVerticalOffset={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 12 : 0}
      >
        <ScrollView
          contentContainerStyle={{
            flexGrow: 1,
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            paddingHorizontal: compact ? 16 : 24,
            paddingVertical: compact ? 16 : 28,
            paddingTop: Math.max(insets.top, 12) + (compact ? 8 : 16),
          }}
          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="always"
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        >
          <View
            className={`w-full ${wide ? 'flex-row items-stretch' : 'flex-col'} ${compact ? 'gap-3' : 'gap-4'}`}
            style={{ maxWidth: wide ? 1040 : 460, gap: wide ? 24 : undefined }}
          >
            {showWelcomeAnimation ? (
              <Animated.View
                style={[
                  heroStyle,
                  wide ? { flex: 0.72, alignSelf: 'center' } : undefined,
                ]}
              >
                <View
                  style={{
                    borderRadius: wide ? 28 : 24,
                    paddingHorizontal: wide ? 18 : 14,
                    paddingVertical: wide ? 16 : compact ? 10 : 12,
                    position: 'relative',
                    overflow: 'hidden',
                    borderWidth: 1,
                    borderColor: '#ffffff',
                    backgroundColor: '#fbfaf5',
                    shadowColor: '#314b3f',
                    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 10 },
                    shadowOpacity: 0.08,
                    shadowRadius: 20,
                    elevation: 3,
                  }}
                >
                  <View
                    pointerEvents="none"
                    style={{
                      position: 'absolute',
                      right: -20,
                      top: -30,
                      width: 130,
                      height: 130,
                      borderRadius: 999,
                      backgroundColor: 'rgba(22, 137, 106, 0.07)',
                    }}
                  />
                  <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between gap-1">
                    <View className="flex-1 gap-1">
                      <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
                        <View
                          className={`${compact ? 'h-9 w-9 rounded-xl' : 'h-10 w-10 rounded-[14px]'} items-center justify-center bg-[#ddf4e6]`}
                          style={{
                            borderWidth: 1,
                            borderColor: '#c4e7d2',
                          }}
                        >
                          <Ionicons
                            name="storefront"
                            size={compact ? 18 : 21}
                            color="#16896a"
                          />
                        </View>
                        <View className="flex-1">
                          <Text
                            numberOfLines={1}
                            className={`${wide ? 'text-[27px]' : compact ? 'text-[21px]' : 'text-[24px]'} font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[#173a32]`}
                            style={{
                              fontFamily: Platform.select({
                                ios: 'Georgia',

                              }),

              </View>
            </Animated.View>
          </View>
        </ScrollView>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </View>
  );
}

import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { ActivityIndicator, Pressable, Text, View, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import Animated, { useAnimatedStyle, useSharedValue, withSpring } from 'react-native-reanimated';

export type ButtonVariant = 'primary' | 'dark' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'danger' | 'dangerOutline';
type ButtonSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

type Props = {
  title: string;
  onPress: () => void;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: keyof typeof Ionicons.glyphMap;
  rightIcon?: keyof typeof Ionicons.glyphMap;
  className?: string;
};

const BOX: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = {
  primary: 'bg-[#16896a] border border-[#117456]',
  dark: 'bg-[#125b49] border border-[#0e4d3e]',
  outline: 'bg-[#fffefa] border border-[#e5e8df]',
  ghost: 'bg-transparent border border-transparent',
  danger: 'bg-[#d66a54] border border-[#c05742]',
  dangerOutline: 'bg-[#fdf3f0] border border-[#efc7be]',
};

const TEXT: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = {
  primary: 'text-white',
  dark: 'text-white',
  outline: 'text-[#243b38]',
  ghost: 'text-[#246b61]',
  danger: 'text-white',
  dangerOutline: 'text-[#b84c37]',
};

const ICON: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = {
  primary: '#ffffff',
  dark: '#ffffff',
  outline: '#16896a',
  ghost: '#16896a',
  danger: '#ffffff',
  dangerOutline: '#c4533d',
};

const SIZE_BOX: Record<ButtonSize, string> = {
  sm: 'rounded-2xl px-3.5 py-2.5 gap-1.5',
  md: 'rounded-2xl px-4 py-3.5 gap-2',
  lg: 'rounded-[20px] px-5 py-4 gap-2.5',
};

const SIZE_TEXT: Record<ButtonSize, string> = {
  sm: 'text-sm font-bold',
  md: 'text-base font-bold',
  lg: 'text-base font-extrabold tracking-tight',
};

const SHADOW: Record<ButtonVariant, ViewStyle> = {
  primary: {
    shadowColor: '#16896a',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
    shadowOpacity: 0.16,
    shadowRadius: 9,
    elevation: 3,
  },
  dark: {
    shadowColor: '#125b49',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
    shadowOpacity: 0.16,
    shadowRadius: 8,
    elevation: 3,
  },
  outline: {
    shadowColor: '#314b3f',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 3 },
    shadowOpacity: 0.06,
    shadowRadius: 7,
    elevation: 1,
  },
  ghost: {},
  danger: {
    shadowColor: '#9e3b27',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
    shadowOpacity: 0.18,
    shadowRadius: 8,
    elevation: 3,
  },
  dangerOutline: {
    shadowColor: '#9e3b27',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 2 },
    shadowOpacity: 0.06,
    shadowRadius: 5,
    elevation: 1,
  },
};

export default function Button({
  title,
  onPress,
  loading = false,
  disabled = false,
  variant = 'primary',
  size = 'md',
  icon,
  rightIcon,
  className = '',
}: Props) {
  const scale = useSharedValue(1);
  const isDisabled = disabled || loading;

  const animatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    transform: [{ scale: scale.get() }],
  }));

  const handlePressIn = () => {
    if (!isDisabled) {
      scale.set(withSpring(0.965, { damping: 16, stiffness: 320 }));
    }
  };

  const handlePressOut = () => {
    scale.set(withSpring(1, { damping: 14, stiffness: 280 }));
  };

  const iconSize = size === 'sm' ? 17 : 20;

  return (
    <View className={`w-full ${className}`}>
      <Animated.View style={[{ width: '100%' }, !isDisabled ? SHADOW[variant] : undefined, animatedStyle]}>
        <Pressable
          onPress={onPress}
          onPressIn={handlePressIn}
          onPressOut={handlePressOut}
          disabled={isDisabled}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityState={{ disabled: isDisabled, busy: loading }}
          className={`w-full flex-row items-center justify-center ${SIZE_BOX[size]} ${BOX[variant]} ${
            isDisabled ? 'opacity-60' : ''
          }`}
          style={{
            borderTopColor: variant === 'primary' || variant === 'dark' ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)' : '#ffffff',
            borderLeftColor: variant === 'primary' || variant === 'dark' ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.16)' : '#ffffff',
          }}
        >
          {loading ? (
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
              <ActivityIndicator color={ICON[variant]} size="small" />
              <Text className={`${SIZE_TEXT[size]} ${TEXT[variant]}`}>Procesando...</Text>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <>
              {icon ? <Ionicons name={icon} size={iconSize} color={ICON[variant]} /> : null}
              <Text className={`${SIZE_TEXT[size]} ${TEXT[variant]}`}>{title}</Text>
              {rightIcon ? <Ionicons name={rightIcon} size={iconSize} color={ICON[variant]} /> : null}
            </>
          )}
        </Pressable>
      </Animated.View>
    </View>
  );
}

import { ReactNode, useCallback } from 'react';
import { View, type StyleProp, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { useFocusEffect } from 'expo-router';
import Animated, {
  useAnimatedStyle,
  useSharedValue,
  withDelay,
  withSpring,
  withTiming,
} from 'react-native-reanimated';

type Props = {
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  delay?: number;
  animated?: boolean;
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
};

type SurfaceProps = Omit<Props, 'delay' | 'animated'>;

function CardSurface({ children, className = '', style }: SurfaceProps) {
  return (
    <View
      className={`rounded-[26px] border bg-[#fffefa] p-4 ${className}`}
      style={[
        {
          borderColor: '#ffffff',
          borderTopColor: '#ffffff',
          borderLeftColor: '#ffffff',
        },
        style,
      ]}
    >
      {children}
    </View>
  );
}

function AnimatedCard({ children, className, delay = 0, style }: Props) {
  const opacity = useSharedValue(1);
  const translateY = useSharedValue(14);
  const scale = useSharedValue(0.975);

  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      opacity.set(1);
      translateY.set(14);
      scale.set(0.975);

      const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        opacity.set(withDelay(delay, withTiming(1, { duration: 380 })));
        translateY.set(withDelay(delay, withSpring(0, { damping: 16, stiffness: 165 })));
        scale.set(withDelay(delay, withSpring(1, { damping: 16, stiffness: 165 })));
      });

      return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    }, [delay, opacity, scale, translateY])
  );

  const animatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    opacity: opacity.get(),
    transform: [{ translateY: translateY.get() }, { scale: scale.get() }],
  }));

  return <Animated.View style={[styles.shadow, animatedStyle, style]}>
    <CardSurface className={className}>{children}</CardSurface>
  </Animated.View>;
}

const styles = {
  shadow: {
    shadowColor: '#51745f',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 5 },
    shadowOpacity: 0.1,
    shadowRadius: 14,
    elevation: 2,
  } as const,
};

export default function Card({
  animated = true,
  children,
  ...props
}: Props) {
  return animated ? (
    <AnimatedCard {...props}>{children}</AnimatedCard>
  ) : (
    <View style={[styles.shadow, props.style]}>
      <CardSurface className={props.className}>{children}</CardSurface>
    </View>
  );
}
