import { colors } from '@/shared/config/theme';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Platform, Pressable, Text, TextInput, TextInputProps, View } from 'react-native';

type Props = TextInputProps & {
  label?: string;
  icon?: keyof typeof Ionicons.glyphMap;
  containerClassName?: string;
};

export default function Input({
  label,
  icon,
  containerClassName = '',
  onFocus,
  onBlur,
  style,
  ...props
}: Props) {
  const [mostrarClave, setMostrarClave] = useState(false);
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false);
  const esClave = props.secureTextEntry === true;

  return (
    <View className={`${containerClassName || 'w-full'} gap-1.5`}>
      {label ? (
        <Text className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5d706c]">{label}</Text>
      ) : null}
      <View
        className="w-full flex-row items-center rounded-2xl"
        style={{
          minHeight: 52,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderColor: focused ? '#5d9c84' : '#e8e9e1',
          backgroundColor: focused ? '#ffffff' : '#f8f8f3',
          shadowColor: '#2c5647',
          shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 2 },
          shadowOpacity: focused ? 0.08 : 0,
          shadowRadius: 5,
          elevation: focused ? 1 : 0,
        }}
      >
        {icon ? (
          <View pointerEvents="none" className="pl-3.5 pr-1">
            <Ionicons name={icon} size={19} color={focused ? colors.brand : colors.muted} />
          </View>
        ) : null}
        <TextInput
          placeholderTextColor={colors.muted}
          autoCapitalize="none"
          editable={props.editable ?? true}
          {...props}
          onFocus={(e) => {
            setFocused(true);
            onFocus?.(e);
          }}
          onBlur={(e) => {
            setFocused(false);
            onBlur?.(e);
          }}
          secureTextEntry={esClave && !mostrarClave}
          style={[
            {
              flex: 1,
              minHeight: 50,
              paddingVertical: Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 14 : 11,
              paddingLeft: icon ? 8 : 16,
              paddingRight: esClave ? 6 : 16,
              fontSize: 16,
              color: '#243b38',
            },
            Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ outlineStyle: 'none' } as any) : null,
            style,
          ]}
        />
        {esClave ? (
          <Pressable
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel={mostrarClave ? 'Ocultar contraseña' : 'Mostrar contraseña'}
            accessibilityHint="Cambia la visibilidad de la contraseña"
            onPress={() => setMostrarClave((visible) => !visible)}
            hitSlop={10}
            className="h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center"
          >
            <Ionicons
              name={mostrarClave ? 'eye-off-outline' : 'eye-outline'}
              size={21}
              color={colors.brand}
            />
          </Pressable>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

import { ReactNode, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useFocusEffect } from 'expo-router';
import type { StyleProp, ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import Animated, {
  useAnimatedStyle,
  useSharedValue,
  withDelay,
  withSpring,
  withTiming,
} from 'react-native-reanimated';

type Props = {
  children: ReactNode;
  delay?: number;
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
};

export default function SectionEntrance({ children, delay = 0, style }: Props) {
  const opacity = useSharedValue(1);
  const translateY = useSharedValue(18);
  const scale = useSharedValue(0.975);

  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      opacity.set(1);
      translateY.set(18);
      scale.set(0.975);

      const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        opacity.set(withDelay(delay, withTiming(1, { duration: 420 })));
        translateY.set(withDelay(delay, withSpring(0, { damping: 16, stiffness: 160 })));
        scale.set(withDelay(delay, withSpring(1, { damping: 16, stiffness: 160 })));
      });

      return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    }, [delay, opacity, scale, translateY])
  );

  const animatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    opacity: opacity.get(),
    transform: [{ translateY: translateY.get() }, { scale: scale.get() }],
  }));

  return <Animated.View style={[{ width: '100%' }, style, animatedStyle]}>{children}</Animated.View>;
}

import { useIsFocused } from 'expo-router';
import LottieView from 'lottie-react-native';
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Text, View } from 'react-native';

type Variant = 'growth' | 'store' | 'sales' | 'cash' | 'business' | 'profile';

const animations = {
  growth: require('../../../assets/lottie/empty.json'),
  store: require('../../../assets/lottie/boxes.json'),
  sales: require('../../../assets/lottie/cart.json'),
  cash: require('../../../assets/lottie/coins.json'),
  business: require('../../../assets/lottie/welcome.json'),
  profile: require('../../../assets/lottie/profile.json'),
};

const surfaces: Record<Variant, { background: string; border: string }> = {
  growth: { background: '#e5f5e7', border: '#cce9d0' },
  store: { background: '#fff2d7', border: '#f0dfb8' },
  sales: { background: '#ffede6', border: '#f4d8ca' },
  cash: { background: '#e4f4eb', border: '#cae7d5' },
  business: { background: '#e6f4e6', border: '#cde6d0' },
  profile: { background: '#f8edcf', border: '#eadcb5' },
};

type Props = {
  variant: Variant;
  title: string;
  caption: string;
};

export default function SectionLottie({ variant, title, caption }: Props) {
  const surface = surfaces[variant];
  const isFocused = useIsFocused();
  const animation = useRef<LottieView>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isFocused) animation.current?.play();
    else animation.current?.pause();
  }, [isFocused]);

  return (
    <View
      className="min-h-[82px] flex-row items-center gap-3 rounded-[24px] border px-3 py-2"
      style={{
        backgroundColor: surface.background,
        borderColor: surface.border,
        shadowColor: '#526b58',
        shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
        shadowOpacity: 0.08,
        shadowRadius: 9,
        elevation: 2,
      }}
    >
      <View className="h-[66px] w-[66px] items-center justify-center">
        <LottieView
          ref={animation}
          source={animations[variant]}
          autoPlay={false}
          loop
          resizeMode="contain"
          style={{ width: 66, height: 66 }}
          webStyle={{ width: 66, height: 66 }}
        />
      </View>
      <View className="flex-1 gap-1">
        <Text className="text-sm font-extrabold text-[#23443a]">{title}</Text>
        <Text className="text-xs leading-4 text-[#61766b]">{caption}</Text>
      </View>
      <View className="mr-1 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-[#39a876]" />
    </View>
  );
}

import { Pressable, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import Animated, { useAnimatedStyle, useSharedValue, withSpring } from 'react-native-reanimated';

type Props = { label: string; onPress: () => void; prefix?: string; className?: string };

export default function TextLink({ label, onPress, prefix, className = '' }: Props) {
  const scale = useSharedValue(1);
  const animatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    transform: [{ scale: scale.get() }],
  }));

  return (
    <View className={`items-center ${className}`}>
      <Animated.View style={animatedStyle}>
        <Pressable
          onPress={onPress}
          onPressIn={() => {
            scale.set(withSpring(0.96, { damping: 15, stiffness: 300 }));
          }}
          onPressOut={() => {
            scale.set(withSpring(1, { damping: 15, stiffness: 300 }));
          }}
          hitSlop={8}
          className="py-1"
        >
          <Text className="text-sm text-[#71817b]">
            {prefix ? `${prefix} ` : ''}
            <Text className="font-bold text-[#246b61] underline">{label}</Text>
          </Text>
        </Pressable>
      </Animated.View>
    </View>
  );
}

import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { ReactNode, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Platform, Pressable, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import Animated, {
  useAnimatedStyle,
  useSharedValue,
  withSpring,
  withTiming,
} from 'react-native-reanimated';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import LogoutButton from '@/features/auth/ui/LogoutButton';

type Props = {
  title: string;
  eyebrow?: string;
  children?: ReactNode;
  /** Muestra el botón de cerrar sesión en la esquina superior derecha. */
  showLogout?: boolean;
  /** Avatar con iniciales en la esquina (por ejemplo, para ir al perfil). */
  avatar?: { text: string; onPress: () => void };
  rightAction?: {
    label: string;
    icon: keyof typeof Ionicons.glyphMap;
    onPress: () => void;
    variant?: 'default' | 'danger';
  };
};

export default function Header({ title, eyebrow, children, rightAction, avatar, showLogout }: Props) {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const btnScale = useSharedValue(1);
  const avatarScale = useSharedValue(1);
  const titleX = useSharedValue(-10);
  const titleOpacity = useSharedValue(1);

  useEffect(() => {
    titleX.set(withSpring(0, { damping: 16, stiffness: 170 }));
    titleOpacity.set(withTiming(1, { duration: 320 }));
  }, [titleOpacity, titleX]);

  const btnStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({ transform: [{ scale: btnScale.get() }] }));
  const avatarStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({ transform: [{ scale: avatarScale.get() }] }));
  const titleStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    opacity: titleOpacity.get(),
    transform: [{ translateX: titleX.get() }],
  }));

  const isDanger = rightAction?.variant === 'danger';

  return (
    <View
      className="bg-[#f3f8f2] px-5 pb-3.5"
      style={{ paddingTop: insets.top + 10 }}
    >
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <Animated.View style={[{ flex: 1 }, titleStyle]}>
          <View className="gap-0.5">
            {eyebrow ? (
              <Text className="text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-[1.4px] text-[#16896a]">
                {eyebrow}
              </Text>
            ) : null}
            <Text
              numberOfLines={1}
              className="text-[26px] font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[#173a32]"
              style={{
                fontFamily: Platform.select({ ios: 'Georgia', android: 'serif', default: 'Georgia' }),
              }}
            >
              {title}
            </Text>
          </View>
        </Animated.View>

        <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
          {rightAction ? (
            <Animated.View style={btnStyle}>
              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel={rightAction.label}
                onPress={rightAction.onPress}
                onPressIn={() => {
                  btnScale.set(withSpring(0.93, { damping: 15, stiffness: 300 }));
                }}
                onPressOut={() => {
                  btnScale.set(withSpring(1, { damping: 14, stiffness: 260 }));
                }}
                className={`h-10 flex-row items-center gap-1.5 rounded-2xl border px-3.5 ${
                  isDanger ? 'border-[#f1d0c8] bg-[#fff4f0]' : 'border-[#e5e8df] bg-[#fffefa]'
                }`}
              >
                <Ionicons
                  name={rightAction.icon}
                  size={17}
                  color={                  isDanger ? '#c4533d' : '#16896a'}
                />
                <Text
                  className={`text-xs font-extrabold ${isDanger ? 'text-[#b84c37]' : 'text-[#193d35]'}`}
                >
                  {rightAction.label}
                </Text>
              </Pressable>
            </Animated.View>
          ) : null}

          {avatar ? (
            <Animated.View style={avatarStyle}>
              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel="Ir a mi cuenta"
                onPress={avatar.onPress}
                onPressIn={() => {
                  avatarScale.set(withSpring(0.9, { damping: 15, stiffness: 320 }));
                }}
                onPressOut={() => {
                  avatarScale.set(withSpring(1, { damping: 12, stiffness: 260 }));
                }}
                className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-white bg-[#16896a]"
                style={{
                  shadowColor: '#125b49',
                  shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 3 },
                  shadowOpacity: 0.14,
                  shadowRadius: 6,
                  elevation: 2,
                }}
              >
                <Text className="text-sm font-extrabold text-white">{avatar.text}</Text>
              </Pressable>
            </Animated.View>
          ) : null}

          {showLogout ? <LogoutButton /> : null}
        </View>
      </View>
      {children}
    </View>
  );
}

import { listarVentasDelPeriodo } from '@/entities/sale/api/ventas';
import { resumirVentasPorCategoria } from '@/entities/sale/model/categorySummary';
import { diasAtras, hoy } from '@/shared/lib/date';
import { showError } from '@/shared/lib/notify';
import type { Venta } from '@/shared/types';
import { useFocusEffect } from 'expo-router';
import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

export function useCategorySales(negocioId?: string) {
  const [ventas, setVentas] = useState<Venta[]>([]);
  const [negocioCargadoId, setNegocioCargadoId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const solicitud = useRef(0);

  const recargar = useCallback(async () => {
    const solicitudActual = ++solicitud.current;
    if (!negocioId) {
      setVentas([]);
      setNegocioCargadoId(null);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const lista = await listarVentasDelPeriodo(negocioId, diasAtras(6), hoy());
      if (solicitudActual === solicitud.current) {
        setVentas(lista);
        setNegocioCargadoId(negocioId);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (solicitudActual === solicitud.current) {
        setVentas([]);
        setNegocioCargadoId(negocioId);
        showError(error, 'No pudimos cargar las ventas por categoría');
      }
    } finally {
      if (solicitudActual === solicitud.current) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [negocioId]);

  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      void recargar();
      return () => {
        solicitud.current += 1;
      };
    }, [recargar]),
  );

  return {
    categorias: resumirVentasPorCategoria(negocioId === negocioCargadoId ? ventas : []),
    loading: loading || Boolean(negocioId && negocioCargadoId !== negocioId),
  };
}

import { diasAtras, hoy } from '@/shared/lib/date';
import { showError } from '@/shared/lib/notify';
import { listarJornadas } from '@/entities/cash/api/jornadas';
import { listarActividadCaja } from '@/entities/cash/api/movimientos';
import type { Jornada, Movimiento } from '@/shared/types';
import { useFocusEffect } from 'expo-router';
import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';

/** Movimientos y jornadas de los últimos 7 días. Se recarga cada vez que la pantalla toma foco. */
export function useDashboardData(negocioId?: string) {
  const [movimientos, setMovimientos] = useState<Movimiento[]>([]);
  const [jornadas, setJornadas] = useState<Jornada[]>([]);

  const recargar = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!negocioId) {
      setMovimientos([]);
      setJornadas([]);
      return;
    }
    try {
      const desde = diasAtras(6);
      const hasta = hoy();
      const [movs, jors] = await Promise.all([
        listarActividadCaja(negocioId, desde, hasta),
        listarJornadas(negocioId, desde, hasta),
      ]);
      setMovimientos(movs);
      setJornadas(jors);
    } catch (e) {
      showError(e, 'No pudimos cargar tu información');
    }
  }, [negocioId]);

  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      recargar();
    }, [recargar])
  );

  return { movimientos, jornadas, recargar };
}

import { iconoNegocio } from '@/shared/config/movimientos';
import { useNegocio } from '@/features/business-management/model/NegocioContext';
import type { Negocio } from '@/shared/types';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Pressable, ScrollView, Text } from 'react-native';
import Animated, { useAnimatedStyle, useSharedValue, withSpring } from 'react-native-reanimated';

function BusinessPill({
  negocio,
  activo,
  onSelect,
}: {
  negocio: Negocio;
  activo: boolean;
  onSelect: () => void;
}) {
  const scale = useSharedValue(1);
  const animatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    transform: [{ scale: scale.get() }],
  }));

  return (
    <Animated.View style={animatedStyle}>
      <Pressable
        onPress={onSelect}
        onPressIn={() => {
          scale.set(withSpring(0.94, { damping: 15, stiffness: 300 }));
        }}
        onPressOut={() => {
          scale.set(withSpring(1, { damping: 14, stiffness: 260 }));
        }}
        className={`flex-row items-center gap-2 rounded-full border px-3.5 py-2 ${
          activo ? 'border-[#1e5b4d] bg-[#1e5b4d]' : 'border-[#e5e8df] bg-[#fffefa]'
        }`}
        style={
          activo
            ? {
                shadowColor: '#246b61',
                shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 3 },
                shadowOpacity: 0.2,
                shadowRadius: 6,
                elevation: 2,
              }
            : undefined
        }
      >
        <Ionicons name={iconoNegocio(negocio.emoji)} size={16} color={activo ? '#ffffff' : '#246b61'} />
        <Text className={`text-xs font-bold ${activo ? 'text-white' : 'text-[#485b57]'}`}>
          {negocio.nombre}
        </Text>
      </Pressable>
    </Animated.View>
  );
}

export default function BusinessSwitcher() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { negocios, selected, select } = useNegocio();
  const newScale = useSharedValue(1);

  const newStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    transform: [{ scale: newScale.get() }],
  }));

  return (
    <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerClassName="gap-2 pt-3.5">
      {negocios.map((n) => (
        <BusinessPill
          key={n.id}
          negocio={n}
          activo={selected?.id === n.id}
          onSelect={() => select(n.id)}
        />
      ))}
      <Animated.View style={newStyle}>
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => router.push('/negocios')}
          onPressIn={() => {
            newScale.set(withSpring(0.94, { damping: 15, stiffness: 300 }));
          }}
          onPressOut={() => {
            newScale.set(withSpring(1, { damping: 14, stiffness: 260 }));
          }}
          className="flex-row items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-dashed border-[#348a76] bg-[#eef5f0] px-3.5 py-2"
        >
          <Ionicons name="add-circle-outline" size={16} color="#246b61" />
          <Text className="text-xs font-bold text-[#246b61]">Nuevo</Text>
        </Pressable>
      </Animated.View>
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

import type { ResumenCategoria } from '@/entities/sale/model/categorySummary';
import Card from '@/shared/ui/Card';
import { money } from '@/shared/lib/format';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Pressable, Text, View } from 'react-native';

type Props = {
  categorias: ResumenCategoria[];
  loading: boolean;
};

export default function CategorySalesCard({ categorias, loading }: Props) {
  const [orden, setOrden] = useState<'ingresos' | 'unidades'>('ingresos');
  const categoriasOrdenadas = useMemo(
    () =>
      [...categorias].sort(
        (a, b) =>
          b[orden] - a[orden] ||
          (orden === 'ingresos' ? b.unidades - a.unidades : b.ingresos - a.ingresos) ||
          a.categoria.localeCompare(b.categoria, 'es'),
      ),
    [categorias, orden],
  );
  const valorTotal = categoriasOrdenadas.reduce((total, categoria) => total + categoria[orden], 0);
  const valorMaximo = categoriasOrdenadas[0]?.[orden] ?? 0;

  return (
    <Card className="gap-3">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
        <View className="flex-1">
          <Text className="text-base font-extrabold text-[#243b38]">Categorías que más venden</Text>
          <Text className="text-xs text-[#71817b]">Ingresos de los últimos 7 días</Text>
        </View>
        <View className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-[#f7efd9]">
          <Ionicons name="podium-outline" size={20} color="#9a6b19" />
        </View>
      </View>

      <View className="flex-row gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-[#f1f0e8] p-1">
        {(['ingresos', 'unidades'] as const).map((opcion) => {
          const activa = orden === opcion;
          return (
            <Pressable
              key={opcion}
              accessibilityRole="button"
              accessibilityState={{ selected: activa }}
              onPress={() => setOrden(opcion)}
              className={`flex-1 items-center rounded-xl py-2 ${
                activa ? 'bg-white' : ''
              }`}
            >
              <Text className={`text-xs font-bold ${activa ? 'text-[#16896a]' : 'text-[#71817b]'}`}>
                {opcion === 'ingresos' ? 'Por ingresos' : 'Por unidades'}
              </Text>
            </Pressable>
          );
        })}
      </View>

      {loading ? (
        <Text className="py-3 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-[#71817b]">
          Cargando ventas por categoría...
        </Text>
      ) : categorias.length === 0 ? (
        <View className="items-center gap-1 border-t border-[#eee8dc] py-4">
          <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#5d706c]">Aún no hay ventas esta semana.</Text>
          <Text className="text-center text-xs text-[#879792]">
            Registra ventas para descubrir qué categorías tienen más movimiento.
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <>
          <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between rounded-2xl bg-[#f4efe4] px-3.5 py-3">
            <View className="flex-1">
              <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#71817b]">
                Categoría líder
              </Text>
              <Text className="mt-0.5 text-sm font-extrabold text-[#243b38]" numberOfLines={1}>
                {categoriasOrdenadas[0].categoria}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <View className="items-end">
              <Text className="text-sm font-black text-[#246b61]">
                {Math.round(
                  valorTotal > 0 ? (categoriasOrdenadas[0][orden] / valorTotal) * 100 : 0,
                )}%
              </Text>
              <Text className="text-[10px] text-[#71817b]">
                {orden === 'ingresos' ? 'de ingresos' : 'de unidades'}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          <View className="gap-3">
            {categoriasOrdenadas.slice(0, 4).map((categoria, index) => {
              const progreso = valorMaximo > 0 ? categoria[orden] / valorMaximo : 0;
              return (
                <View key={categoria.categoria} className="gap-1">
                  <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <View className="flex-1 flex-row items-center gap-2">
                      <View
                        className={`h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${
                          index === 0 ? 'bg-[#ddf4e6]' : 'bg-[#f1f0e8]'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <Text
                          className={`text-[10px] font-black ${
                            index === 0 ? 'text-[#16896a]' : 'text-[#71817b]'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {index + 1}
                        </Text>
                      </View>
                      <Text className="flex-1 text-xs font-bold text-[#344b47]" numberOfLines={1}>
                        {categoria.categoria}
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                    <View className="items-end">
                      <Text className="text-xs font-extrabold text-[#246b61]">
                        {orden === 'ingresos' ? money(categoria.ingresos) : `${categoria.unidades} un.`}
                      </Text>
                      {orden === 'unidades' ? (
                        <Text className="text-[10px] text-[#879792]">{money(categoria.ingresos)}</Text>
                      ) : null}
                    </View>
                  </View>
                  <View className="ml-8 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[#ece6d9]">
                    <View
                      className={`h-full rounded-full ${
                        index === 0 ? 'bg-[#348a76]' : 'bg-[#aec8b5]'
                      }`}
                      style={{ width: `${Math.max(progreso * 100, 4)}%` }}
                    />
                  </View>
                  <Text className="ml-8 text-[10px] text-[#879792]">
                    {categoria.unidades} {categoria.unidades === 1 ? 'unidad' : 'unidades'} ·{' '}
                    {categoria.transacciones}{' '}
                    {categoria.transacciones === 1 ? 'venta' : 'ventas'}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        </>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

import { colors } from '@/shared/config/theme';
import { useCountUp } from '@/shared/lib/hooks/useCountUp';
import { money } from '@/shared/lib/format';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Pressable, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import Animated, {
  useAnimatedStyle,
  useSharedValue,
  withDelay,
  withSpring,
  withTiming,
} from 'react-native-reanimated';

type Props = {
  caja: number;
  ventas: number;
  egresos: number;
  resultadoOperativo: number | null;
};

type KpiItem = {
  titulo: string;
  subtitulo: string;
  valor: number;
  pendiente?: boolean;
  pendienteLabel?: string;
  icono: keyof typeof Ionicons.glyphMap;
  color: string;
};

function KpiCardItem({ item, index }: { item: KpiItem; index: number }) {
  const opacity = useSharedValue(1);
  const translateY = useSharedValue(14);
  const scale = useSharedValue(1);
  const valor = useCountUp(item.valor, 900);

  useEffect(() => {
    const delay = 100 + index * 70;
    opacity.set(withDelay(delay, withTiming(1, { duration: 300 })));
    translateY.set(withDelay(delay, withSpring(0, { damping: 16, stiffness: 180 })));
  }, [index, opacity, translateY]);

  const animatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    opacity: opacity.get(),
    transform: [{ translateY: translateY.get() }, { scale: scale.get() }],
  }));

  return (
    <Animated.View
      style={[
        {
          width: '48.2%',
          shadowColor: '#243b38',
          shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 3 },
          shadowOpacity: 0.06,
          shadowRadius: 8,
          elevation: 2,
        },
        animatedStyle,
      ]}
    >
      <Pressable
        onPressIn={() => {
          scale.set(withSpring(0.97, { damping: 15, stiffness: 300 }));
        }}
        onPressOut={() => {
          scale.set(withSpring(1, { damping: 14, stiffness: 260 }));
        }}
        className="rounded-[26px] border border-white bg-[#fffefa] p-4"
      >
        <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
          <View
            className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl"
            style={{ backgroundColor: item.color + '20' }}
          >
            <Ionicons name={item.icono} size={20} color={item.color} />
          </View>
          <View className="rounded-full bg-[#f4efe4] px-2 py-0.5">
            <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#71817b]">{item.subtitulo}</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
        <Text className="mt-3 text-xs font-semibold text-[#71817b]">{item.titulo}</Text>
        <Text
          className="mt-0.5 text-xl font-extrabold text-[#243b38]"
          numberOfLines={1}
          adjustsFontSizeToFit
          minimumFontScale={0.75}
        >
          {item.pendiente ? (item.pendienteLabel ?? 'Pendiente') : money(valor)}
        </Text>
      </Pressable>
    </Animated.View>
  );
}

export default function KpiGrid({ caja, ventas, egresos, resultadoOperativo }: Props) {
  const items: KpiItem[] = [
    { titulo: 'Dinero en caja', subtitulo: 'Disponible', valor: caja, icono: 'wallet-outline', color: colors.info },
    { titulo: 'Ventas de hoy', subtitulo: 'Ingresos', valor: ventas, icono: 'trending-up-outline', color: colors.brand },
    { titulo: 'Egresos en caja', subtitulo: 'Salidas', valor: egresos, icono: 'trending-down-outline', color: colors.danger },
    {
      titulo: 'Resultado operativo',
      subtitulo:
        resultadoOperativo === null
          ? ventas === 0
            ? 'Sin ventas'
            : 'Costeo pendiente'
          : resultadoOperativo >= 0
            ? 'Positivo'
            : 'Negativo',
      valor: resultadoOperativo ?? 0,
      pendiente: resultadoOperativo === null,
      pendienteLabel: ventas === 0 ? 'Sin ventas' : 'Pendiente',
      icono: 'sparkles-outline',
      color:
        resultadoOperativo === null
          ? colors.warn
          : resultadoOperativo >= 0
            ? colors.brand
            : colors.danger,
    },
  ];

  return (
    <View className="flex-row flex-wrap justify-between gap-y-3">
      {items.map((k, idx) => (
        <KpiCardItem key={k.titulo} item={k} index={idx} />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

import { money } from '@/shared/lib/format';
import type { Pulso } from '@/shared/types';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Text, View } from 'react-native';
import Card from '@/shared/ui/Card';

const COLOR_ESTADO: Record<Pulso['estado'], string> = {
  'sin-datos': '#879792',
  positivo: '#348A76',
  alerta: '#D99A36',
  critico: '#D66A54',
};

function Indicador({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <View className="w-1/2 gap-0.5 py-1">
      <Text className="text-[11px] font-medium text-[#71817b]">{label}</Text>
      <Text className="text-base font-bold text-[#243b38]" numberOfLines={1} adjustsFontSizeToFit>
        {value}
      </Text>
    </View>
  );
}

export default function PulseCard({ pulso }: { pulso: Pulso }) {
  const color = COLOR_ESTADO[pulso.estado];
  const margen =
    pulso.margenOperativo === null
      ? 'No disponible'
      : `${(pulso.margenOperativo * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
  const cobertura =
    pulso.coberturaCosteo === null ? 'No disponible' : `${(pulso.coberturaCosteo * 100).toFixed(0)}%`;

  return (
    <Card animated={false} className="gap-4">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <View className="flex-1 gap-2">
          <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#71817b]">
            Rentabilidad registrada · últimos 7 días
          </Text>
          <View
            className="flex-row items-center gap-2 self-start rounded-full px-3 py-1"
            style={{ backgroundColor: `${color}22` }}
          >
            <View className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: color }} />
            <Text className="text-xs font-extrabold" style={{ color }}>
              {pulso.titulo}
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>
        <View
          className="h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl"
          style={{ backgroundColor: `${color}18` }}
        >
          <Ionicons name="analytics-outline" size={22} color={color} />
        </View>
      </View>

      <View className="rounded-2xl bg-[#f7f2e7] p-3.5">
        <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#71817b]">Resultado operativo registrado</Text>
        <Text
          className="mt-1 text-3xl font-extrabold"
          style={{
            color:
              pulso.resultadoOperativo === null
                ? COLOR_ESTADO.alerta
                : pulso.resultadoOperativo < 0
                  ? COLOR_ESTADO.critico
                  : '#243b38',
          }}
          numberOfLines={1}
          adjustsFontSizeToFit
          minimumFontScale={0.75}
        >
          {pulso.resultadoOperativo === null
            ? pulso.ventas === 0
              ? 'Sin ventas'
              : 'Pendiente'
            : money(pulso.resultadoOperativo)}
        </Text>
        <Text className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-[#71817b]">
          Ventas − costo directo vendido − gastos operativos registrados
        </Text>
      </View>

      <View className="flex-row flex-wrap">
        <Indicador label="Ventas registradas" value={money(pulso.ventas)} />
        <Indicador label="Costo directo vendido" value={money(pulso.costoVentas)} />
        <Indicador label="Gastos operativos" value={money(pulso.gastosOperativos)} />
        <Indicador label="Compras pagadas (caja)" value={money(pulso.compras)} />
        <Indicador label="Margen operativo" value={margen} />
        <Indicador label="Ventas con costo" value={`${pulso.ventasConCosto} de ${pulso.ventasConCosto + pulso.ventasSinCosto}`} />
        <Indicador label="Cobertura del costeo" value={cobertura} />
        <Indicador label="Días con ventas" value={`${pulso.diasConVentas} de 7`} />
      </View>

      <View className="flex-row items-start gap-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#f7f2e7] p-3">
        <Ionicons name="bulb-outline" size={18} color="#d99a36" style={{ marginTop: 1 }} />
        <Text className="flex-1 text-xs leading-4.5 text-[#5d706c]">
          <Text className="font-bold text-[#243b38]">Lectura: </Text>
          {pulso.consejo}
        </Text>
      </View>

      <Text className="text-[10px] leading-4 text-[#879792]">
        Margen operativo = (ventas − costo directo vendido − gastos operativos) ÷ ventas. Las
        compras afectan la caja, pero no se restan otra vez del resultado; se requiere costear cada
        venta. No contempla impuestos ni costos no registrados.
      </Text>
    </Card>
  );
}

import { TIPOS } from '@/shared/config/movimientos';
import { money } from '@/shared/lib/format';
import type { Movimiento } from '@/shared/types';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Pressable, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import Card from '@/shared/ui/Card';

export default function RecentMovements({ movimientos }: { movimientos: Movimiento[] }) {
  const router = useRouter();

  return (
    <Card delay={240} className="gap-1">
      <View className="mb-1 flex-row items-center justify-between">
        <Text className="text-base font-bold text-[#243b38]">Últimos movimientos</Text>
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => router.push('/caja')}
          className="flex-row items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-[#e6f0e9] px-3 py-1 active:opacity-75"
        >
          <Text className="text-xs font-bold text-[#246b61]">Ir a Caja</Text>
          <Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={13} color="#246b61" />
        </Pressable>
      </View>
      {movimientos.length === 0 ? (
        <View className="items-center gap-2 py-4">
          <View className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#f4efe4]">
            <Ionicons name="receipt-outline" size={20} color="#879792" />
          </View>
          <Text className="text-center text-sm text-[#71817b]">
            Aún no registras movimientos. Ve a la pestaña Caja para empezar.
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        movimientos.slice(0, 5).map((m, idx, arr) => {
          const t = TIPOS[m.tipo];
          const isLast = idx === arr.length - 1;
          return (
            <View
              key={m.id}
              className={`flex-row items-center gap-3 py-3 ${!isLast ? 'border-b border-[#ece6da]' : ''}`}
            >
              <View
                className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl"
                style={{ backgroundColor: t.color + '20' }}
              >
                <Ionicons name={t.icon} size={18} color={t.color} />
              </View>
              <View className="flex-1">
                <Text className="font-bold text-[#243b38]" numberOfLines={1}>
                  {m.concepto}
                </Text>
                <Text className="text-xs text-[#879792]">
                  {m.fecha} · {t.label}
                  {m.cliente ? ` · ${m.cliente}` : ''}
                </Text>
              </View>
              <Text className="text-base font-extrabold" style={{ color: t.color }}>
                {t.signo}
                {money(m.monto)}
              </Text>
            </View>
          );
        })
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

import { colors } from '@/shared/config/theme';
import { diasAtras, hoy, inicialDia } from '@/shared/lib/date';
import { money } from '@/shared/lib/format';
import { sumar } from '@/entities/cash/model/pulse';
import type { Movimiento } from '@/shared/types';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Text, View } from 'react-native';
import Animated, {
  useAnimatedStyle,
  useSharedValue,
  withDelay,
  withSpring,
} from 'react-native-reanimated';
import Card from '@/shared/ui/Card';

const ALTO_MAX = 88;

function AnimatedBar({
  targetHeight,
  color,
  delay,
}: {
  targetHeight: number;
  color: string;
  delay: number;
}) {
  const height = useSharedValue(4);

  useEffect(() => {
    height.set(4);
    height.set(
      withDelay(delay, withSpring(Math.max(4, targetHeight), { damping: 15, stiffness: 150 })),
    );
  }, [delay, height, targetHeight]);

  const animatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    height: height.get(),
  }));

  return (
    <Animated.View
      style={[
        {
          width: 11,
          backgroundColor: color,
          borderTopLeftRadius: 6,
          borderTopRightRadius: 6,
        },
        animatedStyle,
      ]}
    />
  );
}

export default function WeekChart({ movimientos }: { movimientos: Movimiento[] }) {
  const fechaHoy = hoy();
  const dias = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => {
    const fecha = diasAtras(6 - i);
    const delDia = movimientos.filter((m) => m.fecha === fecha);
    return {
      fecha,
      inicial: inicialDia(fecha),
      esHoy: fecha === fechaHoy,
      ventas: sumar(delDia, 'venta'),
      egresos: sumar(delDia, 'gasto', 'compra'),
    };
  });

  const maximo = Math.max(1, ...dias.flatMap((d) => [d.ventas, d.egresos]));
  const totalVentas = dias.reduce((acc, d) => acc + d.ventas, 0);
  const totalEgresos = dias.reduce((acc, d) => acc + d.egresos, 0);

  return (
    <Card delay={180} className="gap-3.5">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
        <View>
          <Text className="text-base font-bold text-[#243b38]">Actividad de la semana</Text>
          <Text className="text-xs text-[#71817b]">
            Ventas {money(totalVentas)} · Gastos {money(totalEgresos)}
          </Text>
        </View>
        <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3">
          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
            <View className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: colors.brand }} />
            <Text className="text-xs font-medium text-[#71817b]">Ventas</Text>
          </View>
          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
            <View className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: colors.accent }} />
            <Text className="text-xs font-medium text-[#71817b]">Gastos</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>

      <View className="h-32 flex-row items-end justify-between rounded-2xl bg-[#f7f2e7]/80 px-3 pb-2.5 pt-4">
        {dias.map((d, index) => (
          <View key={d.fecha} className="items-center gap-1.5">
            <View className="flex-row items-end gap-1">
              <AnimatedBar
                targetHeight={(d.ventas / maximo) * ALTO_MAX}
                color={colors.brand}
                delay={120 + index * 45}
              />
              <AnimatedBar
                targetHeight={(d.egresos / maximo) * ALTO_MAX}
                color={colors.accent}
                delay={145 + index * 45}
              />
            </View>
            <View
              className={`rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 ${
                d.esHoy ? 'bg-[#246b61]' : 'bg-transparent'
              }`}
            >
              <Text
                className={`text-[10px] font-bold ${
                  d.esHoy ? 'text-white' : 'text-[#71817b]'
                }`}
              >
                {d.esHoy ? 'Hoy' : d.inicial}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        ))}
      </View>
    </Card>
  );
}

import { hoy } from '@/shared/lib/date';
import { showError } from '@/shared/lib/notify';
import { listarProductos } from '@/entities/product/api/productos';
import { listarVentasDelDia } from '@/entities/sale/api/ventas';
import type { Producto, Venta } from '@/shared/types';
import { useFocusEffect } from 'expo-router';
import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

export function useStockData(negocioId?: string) {
  const [productos, setProductos] = useState<Producto[]>([]);
  const [ventas, setVentas] = useState<Venta[]>([]);
  const [negocioCargadoId, setNegocioCargadoId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const solicitud = useRef(0);

  const recargar = useCallback(async () => {
    const solicitudActual = ++solicitud.current;
    if (!negocioId) {
      setProductos([]);
      setVentas([]);
      setNegocioCargadoId(null);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [listaProductos, listaVentas] = await Promise.all([
        listarProductos(negocioId),
        listarVentasDelDia(negocioId, hoy()),
      ]);
      if (solicitudActual !== solicitud.current) return;
      setProductos(listaProductos);
      setVentas(listaVentas);
      setNegocioCargadoId(negocioId);
    } catch (error) {
      if (solicitudActual === solicitud.current) {
        setProductos([]);
        setVentas([]);
        setNegocioCargadoId(negocioId);
        showError(error, 'No pudimos cargar el inventario');
      }
    } finally {
      if (solicitudActual === solicitud.current) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [negocioId]);

  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      void recargar();
    }, [recargar])
  );

  const datosActuales = negocioId === negocioCargadoId;
  return {
    productos: datosActuales ? productos : [],
    ventas: datosActuales ? ventas : [],
    loading: loading || Boolean(negocioId && !datosActuales),
    recargar,
  };
}
